problem: The test header cites init.ts:624 and init.ts:1089; after a91679b9 those symbols are at :625 and :1099.

suggested_fix: Name the symbol rather than the line, as the same commit did for update.test.ts and skills-install-warnings.test.ts.
evidence: installGdskills is at src/commands/init.ts:625 and the Warnings print at :1099 at 731a8ef1; the commit added ten lines above both.

verification.evidence: Checked at ae2ff9b7, the tree that carries bbd6e7ce, which is where this finding was fixed. The header of src/commands/init.test.ts no longer carries line numbers; it names the symbol and the behaviour, matching the style the same commit gave update.test.ts and skills-install-warnings.test.ts. Nothing in the file cites init.ts:624 or :1089 any more.

disposition.evidence: bbd6e7ce — the header names the symbol and the behaviour instead of line numbers, matching update.test.ts and skills-install-warnings.test.ts.

problem: The new Notices print is asserted at only one of its three call sites; skills.ts and init.ts print it untested.
impact: A regression that drops the Notices print in either command survives a green run — the same failure mode those files' headers record as round-1 finding T-001, reintroduced for the new heading.
suggested_fix: Add one assertion per uncovered call site, mirroring src/commands/update.test.ts:146.
evidence: Deleting both print blocks in a scratch copy (heading("Notices") count 0, console.log("Notices:") gone) leaves install.test.ts, update.test.ts, skills-install-warnings.test.ts and init.test.ts at 48 pass / 0 fail.

verification.evidence: Checked at ae2ff9b7, the tree that carries bbd6e7ce, which is where this finding was fixed. In a scratch copy, deleting the Notices block at skills.ts:125-130 and at init.ts:1093-1098 turns each command's new test red at `noticesAt > -1`. Each test also asserts that the removal line's index is greater than noticesAt and that a Warnings heading never appears, so ordering is checked rather than mere presence.

disposition.evidence: bbd6e7ce — one test each added to skills-install-warnings.test.ts and init.test.ts; deleting either print block turns its test red, and each asserts the Notices heading comes before the removal line.

problem: The rewritten refusal infers that the citation would resolve in this tree and break in another; the sweep resolves paths against defaultBundledRoot(), under which none of the seven exists.
impact: A recorded justification states something the code would not do, which is the defect the rewrite was meant to remove.
suggested_fix: Say the seven exist at the repository root and that the sweep's own root would not see them either — the citation would break in every tree.
evidence: existsSync(path.join(root, resolved)) at bundled-eval.ts:1558 with root = defaultBundledRoot() = src/gdskills/bundled (:1740). Measured: 7 of 17 exist under the repo root, 0 under the bundled root.

verification.evidence: Checked at ae2ff9b7, the tree that carries bbd6e7ce, which is where this finding was fixed. An independent extractor replicating PATH_REFERENCE with docs/ added, run over the bundled tree, returns 17 distinct paths: 7 exist under the repository root and 0 under defaultBundledRoot(), which is exactly what the corrected sentence claims. GENERATED_PATH_ROOTS holds only rules/entrypoints/, so all 17 would indeed be findings. The counts, the six generated names and the package.json files bullet are unchanged and correct.

disposition.evidence: bbd6e7ce — re-measured at both roots (7 exist at the repo root, 0 under defaultBundledRoot()); the text now says the citation would break in every tree, which is the stronger reason to refuse.
